1758 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
From 05-22 to end of year: May (9 days left) + Jun 30 + Jul 31 + Aug 31 + Sep 30 + Oct 31 + Nov 30 + Dec 31 = 9+30+31+31+30+31+30+31 = 223 days.  
325 - 223 = 102 days into 1759.  
1759 is common year: Jan 31, Feb 28 → 31+28=59, remaining 102-59=43 days into March → March 43rd = April 12 (since March has 31 days, 43-31=12 April).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1759-04-12
